'recycler' means any natural or legal person who carries out recycling in a permitted facility;

requirements.rationale: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 defines a recycler as any person who carries out recycling in a permitted facility (Art. 3(1)(58)), and preparation for recycling, the storage, handling and dismantling of battery packs, as treatment before any recycling process (Art. 3(1)(54)). Section 1 point 7 of the Annex to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/606 defines the first recycler as the recycler who starts the recycling of the modules or cells, for example by generating black mass, and excludes an operator who only prepares for recycling. Section 1 point 5 makes black mass an intermediate fraction whose metals need further processing, so a recycling chain spans several facilities when one recycler generates the black mass and another recycler recovers the metals from the black mass. A recycling at one facility makes that recycler the first recycler. Art. 75(5) second subparagraph of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 and section 5 point 3 of the Annex give the first recycler the duty to gather the information of the whole chain.
